Your resume might look completely fine to you... and still have one line that gets you skipped immediately.

That's the problem with a lot of resume advice. People will spend 20 minutes arguing about colors, fonts, typos, page length, and whether your bullet points need periods while completely missing the giant red flag sitting directly in front of them.
